title: Overwatch brings back 6v6 Role Queue on December 8 🛡️
subject: overwatch
description:
Are you queueing 2-2-2 or sticking with 5v5? 👇

Blizzard announced that Overwatch Season 6 adds a 6v6 Role Queue Competitive mini season on December 8, 2026. It runs for four weeks alongside 5v5 Role Queue and 6v6 Open Queue, with matchmaking changes aimed at queue times.

Sources: Blizzard Director's Take by Aaron Keller (Nov 10, 2026), VGC (Nov 10, 2026), Inven Global (Nov 10, 2026)
Game footage © Blizzard Entertainment.

scenes.text: Overwatch is bringing back 6v6 Role Queue.
On December 8, Season 6 adds a 2-2-2 Role Queue to Competitive: two tanks, two damage, two supports.
It runs as a four-week mini season, next to standard 5v5 and 6v6 Open Queue.
Blizzard cut teams to five players when Overwatch 2 launched in 2022, and held this mode back over fears of long queues.
Game director Aaron Keller says matchmaking changes shipping with Season 6 should keep queue times manageable.
